title: 100% AI generated AARPG - DAY 7 UPDATE [Boss fight, Multiplayer)
author: sharkymcstevenson2
selftext:
Hey everyone,

Here's the latest update on my D2 inspired AARPG I've been working on - haven't written a single line of code and I've been able to create an almost finished game by now using my own engine 

\- Added multiplayer   
\- Bossfight, epic loot  
\- Main menu   
\- Updated name to HELL-VAIN (thanks for the feedback on the old one!)

Still havent figured out the clothing for my wizard class yet, 

Please let me know your feedback!

replies.author: sharkymcstevenson2
replies.body:
Hey, thanks for the feedback 

The reason we don’t offer a free tier currently is because the cost to generate games is quite extensive, but we might introduce a free tier soon where curious users can play around with earlier models. We want users to be able to try a little bit before committing, at the same time it has to be feasible economically, so trying to find a good balance there

The reason for the templates is simply ease of use - we want to give new user a quick way to get started on something and iterate from there, since the engine cannot one-shot games yet, giving users a solid base to work from is a good start

But we might introduce a free-base mode for users who are a little more advanced, if there is enough users asking for it

Happy to answer any more questions in the DM, and give you 1k free credits to start playing around with :). The pro plan gives the user enough credits to make 1-5 games depending on how much time and polish they put into their games

Hope that answers your questions!
